title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning Court Costs in Civil Litigation

articles.content_en: 1. Regarding the issue of how the litigation fees of the first instance shall be borne when the People's Court of second instance conducts mediation in hearing an appeal case. According to Article 153 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China (for Trial Implementation), where the People's Court of second instance hears an appeal case and reaches an agreement through mediation, the judgment of the People's Court of first instance shall be deemed revoked, and the part concerning the bearing of litigation fees shall also be deemed revoked. Therefore, during the mediation process of the second instance, the bearing of litigation fees for the first and second instances shall be negotiated by both parties, and if an agreement is reached, it shall be specified in the mediation document.

2. Regarding the issue of how to collect case fees in cases with more than two subject matters of action. The plaintiff has raised more than two claims in the same case. After accepting the case, the People's Court shall adjudicate the different claims separately. Moreover, the outcome of adjudication of one claim shall not affect the adjudication of other claims. Therefore, when handling such cases, the acceptance fees shall be calculated separately according to different subject matters of action and collected in aggregate.

3. Regarding the issue of whether the People's Court of second instance shall rectify the error in the collection of litigation fees by the People's Court of first instance. When hearing an appeal case, if the People's Court of second instance finds that the People's Court of first instance correctly handled the substantive part of the case but erroneously collected litigation fees, it shall make corrections in the final judgment.
Reply hereby.
June 21, 1986
